description_en: Queries the auto-renewal attributes of one or more elasticity assurances
description_zh: 查询一个或多个弹性保障服务的自动续费属性
name: DescribeElasticityAssuranceAutoRenewAttribute

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the elasticity assurance. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 弹性保障服务所属的地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The list of elasticity assurance IDs. This parameter is required. If this parameter is not specified, the API returns MissingParameter.PrivatePoolOptionsId.

Limits: You can query up to 50 elasticity assurances at a time
parameters.help_zh:
弹性保障服务ID列表。此参数为必填项，未提供时接口返回 MissingParameter.PrivatePoolOptionsId。

限制：单次查询的弹性保障服务数量最多不超过50个
parameters.name: private_pool_options_id

schema.description_en: The information about the queried elasticity assurances
schema.description_zh: 查询的弹性保障服务信息集合

ElasticityAssuranceRenewAttribute.description_en: The auto-renewal attributes of the elasticity assurances
ElasticityAssuranceRenewAttribute.description_zh: 弹性保障服务自动续费属性组成的数组

items.description_en: The auto-renewal attribute of the elasticity assurance
items.description_zh: 弹性保障服务自动续费属性

Period.description_en: The auto-renewal period. Valid values: 1, 2, 3, 6, 12, 24, and 36

PeriodUnit.description_en:
The unit of the auto-renewal period. Valid values:

Month (default)
Year
PeriodUnit.description_zh:
自动续费时长的单位，可能值：

Month（默认）
Year

PrivatePoolOptionsId.description_en: The ID of the elasticity assurance

RenewalStatus.description_en:
Indicates whether the elasticity assurance is automatically renewed. Valid values:

AutoRenewal: Auto-renewal is enabled.

Normal: Auto-renewal is disabled.

NotRenewal: The elasticity assurance is not renewed
RenewalStatus.description_zh:
是否自动续费弹性保障。可能值：

AutoRenewal：设置为自动续费。

Normal：取消自动续费。

NotRenewal：不再续费
